name: @pgmi-builds/agent-agy-sdk
description: Google Antigravity (Gemini) provider for DeepSeek Harness (dsh) — the OPT-IN SDK transport: drives the google-antigravity Python SDK through a JSONL stdio bridge (bridge/agy_bridge.py, localharness embedded). Auth: adapter-side/GEMINI_API_KEY key, else Vertex over ADC. The agy CLI is never invoked — that is @pgmi-builds/agent-agy. Delivered DISABLED by default (roster key `agy-sdk`): the CLI adapter is the primary path because it reuses the user's existing Antigravity environment. No Python dependency is declared anywhere and there is no postinstall/allow-scripts hook — the durable venv is fetched into the world home on first real use (src/sdk-venv.ts, `npm run fetch-venv`).
